<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_CareerDevelopment" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_CareerDevelopment" name="Employee Development and Promotion" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Roles">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_DevelopmentNeed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IdentifyNeeds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnhanceSkills</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Promoted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideFeedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConsiderForPromotion</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="HR">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewPerformance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinalizePromotion</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NotApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeed" name="Development need or career aspiration identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_IdentifyNeeds" name="Identify development needs or career aspirations">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" name="Create personal development plan">
      <bpmn:documentation>The plan may include training programs, mentorship, or additional responsibilities.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Start parallel development activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnhanceSkills" name="Work on skill enhancement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide feedback and evaluation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Development activities completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConsiderForPromotion" name="Consider employee for promotion or new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewPerformance" name="Conduct formal performance review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approved" name="Review approved?" default="Flow_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FinalizePromotion" name="Finalize promotion with new responsibilities and compensation adjustments">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Promoted" name="Employee promoted and transitions into new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="Promotion not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeed" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds" targetRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_EnhanceSkills"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_EnhanceSkills" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_ConsiderForPromotion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderForPromotion" targetRef="Task_ReviewPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ReviewPerformance" targetRef="Gateway_Approved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approved" targetRef="Task_FinalizePromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approved" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_FinalizePromotion" targetRef="EndEvent_Promoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
